label: pre_llm
description: Components that prepare, clean, retrieve, route, redact, budget, or enrich inputs before a model call.

label: llm
description: Components that perform model calls or model-compatible inference through local, hosted, browser-based, or API-backed runtimes.

label: post_llm
description: Components that verify, score, normalize, cite, redact, escalate, or persist model outputs after inference.

label: control_flow
description: Components that organize execution order across other components, including loops, retries, branches, parallel work, and human review gates.

label: data
description: Components that store, load, index, shard, deduplicate, or export source records, components, subcomponents, labels, dimensions, vectors, and traces.

label: evaluation
description: Components that benchmark pipelines, compare model routes, score outputs, and decide whether a template is good enough to publish or reuse.

label: loop
description: Repeat a group of steps until a stop condition, reviewer decision, quality threshold, or budget limit is reached.

label: iterate
description: Run retrieval, model, verification, and refinement cycles to improve a result without losing traceability between passes.

label: branch
description: Choose different component paths based on modality, risk, jurisdiction, confidence, tenant policy, or cost threshold.

label: parallel
description: Run independent tools, searches, model calls, or verification checks concurrently and merge their results with deterministic precedence rules.

label: retry
description: Retry failed or low-confidence steps with bounded attempts, backoff, alternate model routes, or alternate tools.

label: human_review
description: Escalate high-risk, ambiguous, or publisher-sensitive outputs to vetted people and ingest their response as signed or reviewable knowledge.

label: cache_lookup
description: Check prompt-prefix, trajectory-fragment, embedding, or component-template caches before running expensive model calls.
